title: Field pairing generator
statement: Let $d,\ell$ be natural numbers with $\ell\ne0$, let $a_0,\ldots,a_{d-1}$ be elements of the binary extension field of degree $\ell$, and let $s$ be another element of that field. Define a binary vector of length $d$ whose $i$-th coordinate is the binary dot product of the binary encodings of $a_i$ and $s$.
hypotheses_covered: $a$ assigns a field element to each index below $d$
$s$ is in the binary extension field of degree $\ell$
